answer: Require every agent to lock a real stake in a shared vault before it can transact, so creating an identity stops being free. Think of the stake like a walnut: cracking one shell is cheap, but opening ten thousand costs serious capital, and each fake identity needs its own. The vault releases rewards only after a delayed audit of real behavior, and any proven sybil cluster forfeits its stake to honest agents. Reputation is a relic: non-transferable, earned slowly, impossible to buy. A fresh puppet starts at zero trust, so mass fakery costs more than it can ever earn.
